Landed. validateDesignId validates and preserves; allowDot removed (it was a formatting flag, not a parsing one). It rejects rather than rewrites: blank, embedded control characters, and leading/trailing whitespace are InvalidId — a trimming parser is not injective either, since ' x ' and 'x' would share an id. The round-trip law is asserted for all five id types over an 11-string corpus in IdRoundTripProbeSuite, whose three characterization assertions are flipped.

Two call sites genuinely depended on the old rewrite and were made explicit rather than silently dropped: CellSelector.factor and ContrastExpr.oneway/interaction match a FactorId against Event.factor's Names.sanitize'd varName, so they normalize into that vocabulary through one designFactorId helper. The lossy step is now visible at the call site that needs it instead of hidden inside FactorId.apply.

design 153 -> 155 tests, JVM+JS green.
